files.docs/02-elaboration/ui-ux/components.md: Content strings: email label 'Email address'; password label 'Password'; submit label 'Sign in'; loading label 'Signing in…'; invalid error 'Email address or password is incorrect'; dashboard heading 'Dashboard'; dashboard welcome 'Welcome, {userName}'. EmailField: type=email, autocomplete=email, inputmode=email, visible label using font.body family/size/weight/lineHeight, height control.height, horizontal padding space.md, border border.width.default color.border.default, radius radius.md, input text uses font.body tokens; focus-visible shadow.focus. PasswordField: type=password, autocomplete=current-password, visible label and same tokenized field styling. SubmitButton: height control.height, padding space.xs space.md, radius radius.md, text color.text.onPrimary and font.body tokens, default color.action.primary, hover color.action.primaryHover, disabled color.action.disabled, focus-visible shadow.focus. LoginForm props: email, password, status(default|loading|error), errorMessage, onSubmit. Structure: EmailField, PasswordField, SubmitButton, role=alert ErrorMessage. Auto-layout vertical, gap space.md, padding space.md. Loading disables submit and exposes aria-busy=true. ErrorMessage uses color.text.error on color.surface.error and font.body tokens, receives focus and announces role=alert. Keyboard order: email, password, submit. DashboardScreen props: userName; semantic main with h1 'Dashboard' using font.heading tokens and welcome text 'Welcome, {userName}' using font.body tokens; focus moves to h1 after successful navigation.
files.docs/02-elaboration/ui-ux/layout.md: Traceability: FR-01 -> LoginScreen -> SC-01 and SC-02; successful SC-01 navigates to DashboardScreen. Mobile below layout.breakpoint.tablet: one column, space.md gutters, form and dashboard fill available width. Tablet from layout.breakpoint.tablet to layout.breakpoint.desktop: LoginForm and DashboardScreen centered and capped at layout.content.formMax. Desktop from layout.breakpoint.desktop: DashboardScreen centered and capped at layout.content.pageMax; LoginForm remains capped at layout.content.formMax. Constraints: container stretches to viewport then caps; fields stretch horizontally. Login states: default, loading, error. Dashboard state: authenticated success. Contrast target WCAG AA; labels remain visible; focus order follows document order.
